fact: The Department of E-Government says immigration e-services are being integrated onto the Bomalathu single digital services portal so the public can access selected immigration services online, with the Malawi Revenue Authority and National Registration Bureau already using it and 25 e-services being onboarded.
DMAP describes the Bomalathu eService Portal as a one-stop national platform letting citizens access government services online.
Minister Charles Mhango says the Malawi Business Registration System lets businesses register and maintain records online; one online service is named.
The E-Government Director said citizens increasingly interact with public institutions through the 'Boma Lathu' e-services portal; no count of services given.
